set -euo pipefail
BASE_URL="${1:?usage: poc.sh BASE_URL PATH TEST_PARAM SESSION_FILE}"

# 正常输入对照
curl -s -b "$SESSION_FILE" "${BASE_URL}${PATH_PART}?${PARAM_NAME}=1" -o /tmp/sqli001_normal.out
# 最小测试输入：闭合单引号并附加恒真条件

echo '--- normal ---'
cat /tmp/sqli001_normal.out
echo '--- test ---'
cat /tmp/sqli001_test.out
